description: Parameter sets for radiolaria.swarm, loaded with radiolaria.swarm(p5, { preset: '<name>' }) or swarm.load('<name>').

presets.name: default
presets.description: The starting point: a bass peak grows one medium specimen, which holds for four seconds and dissolves. Up to ten at a time.

presets.name: bass-kick
presets.description: One specimen per kick drum: snappy, small, gone again in two seconds, so the canvas follows the beat.

presets.name: gentle
presets.description: Few, large and slow: a loud passage opens one specimen over four seconds and keeps it for twelve, like a slide being drawn.

presets.name: storm
presets.description: A low threshold and almost no cooldown: the canvas fills with small specimens and the oldest are pushed out while they are still alive.

presets.name: highs-sparkle
presets.description: Watches the top bin, so hi-hats and consonants put small bright skeletons near the edges.

presets.name: mids-bloom
presets.description: Follows voices and leads in the mid bin, with thorny bushes and baskets that unfold slowly and overlap.

presets.name: sparse-plate
presets.description: Only four at a time, well apart and held for a long time: the specimens read as a plate being filled in rather than as a reaction.

presets.name: ink-drops
presets.description: Dark engraved rings and stars on paper, one per peak, with no glow, so it layers well under hydra feedback.

presets.name: silent-pulse
presets.description: No microphone needed: a test level pulses every 1.2 seconds, so the lifecycle, the spacing and the overflow can be watched without any sound.

presets.name: silent-mouse
presets.description: No microphone needed: the mouse's x position is the level, so a peak can be played by hand to find a threshold that feels right.
